banner.simulated: Simulated data. Every patient, message and case shown here is synthetic.

errors.unreachable: The simulator could not be reached.
errors.notJson: The simulator's answer was not understood.

inbox.title: Patient inbox
inbox.description: What CareLoop sent, shown the way each channel shows it, with the actions a patient can take. A delivered message is not an acknowledgement: only the patient's own action is.
inbox.empty: No messages in this inbox yet. A message appears here when CareLoop sends a notification.
inbox.notAnswerable: This message did not reach the patient, so the patient cannot respond to it.

app.talkBody: Your care team can call you and explain anything again.
app.thanksAcknowledged: We have told the clinic you will come.
app.thanksCallRequested: We have asked your care team to call you.
app.teachBackLabel: One question, so we know we explained it well

answer.understand: Follow the next step in my message
answer.wait: Wait for the hospital to call me

app.rateHeading: How sure do you feel about what happens next?

sms.caption: A text message on a basic phone with no internet. Reply 1 to say you will come, or 2 to ask for a call. Any other reply is refused and nothing is sent to CareLoop.

email.readOnly: A caregiver's copy. Only the patient can reply to the clinic, so there is nothing here to answer and nothing the caregiver does is reported as the patient's.

records.heading: What CareLoop records

deliveryDetail.Pending: CareLoop has not accepted a delivery report for this message.
deliveryDetail.Delivered: A delivery report was sent. Delivery is not an acknowledgement.
deliveryDetail.Silent: The channel stayed silent, so CareLoop's own deadline has to notice.

responseDetail.Acknowledged: The patient said they will come.
responseDetail.Understood: The patient said the next step back.
responseDetail.CallRequested: The patient asked for a call. This is not an acknowledgement.

records.confidenceDetail: A rating is a measure, not an acknowledgement.
records.caregiverDetail: Nothing a caregiver does is recorded as the patient's.

caseStatus.title: Case status
caseStatus.description: What the patient can see about their follow-up, read from the CareLoop case Task. It shows where the follow-up stands and never any clinical detail.
caseStatus.notFound: CareLoop has no case with that identifier.

patientBehaviours.title: Patient behaviours
patientBehaviours.description: Choose how each simulated patient reacts when CareLoop notifies them. A patient only reacts to a notification that arrives, and delivery is never an acknowledgement.
patientBehaviours.defaultDescription: Used for every patient that has no behaviour of their own.
patientBehaviours.listEmpty: No patient has a behaviour of their own. Every patient gets the default.
patientBehaviours.patientIdHint: Must be synthetic: it starts with SYN-.

validation.patientId: The patient identifier must start with SYN-.
validation.failureReason: A delivery that fails needs a reason.
validation.confidence: A patient who only rates confidence needs a rating.
validation.respondAfter: The delay must be zero or more seconds.
validation.respondToNotification: The notification number must be 1 or more.

patientBehaviours.responseNeedsDelivery: A patient can only respond to a delivered notification.

scenarioRunner.title: Scenario runner
scenarioRunner.description: Put the patient behaviours of a shared scenario in force, then watch how those patients react to CareLoop's notifications. A run sends nothing by itself.
scenarioRunner.cohort: A cohort cannot be run here. Run the scenarios it draws from.
scenarioRunner.unusable: This scenario file cannot be used: {{problem}}

status.Running: Running: waiting for and reacting to notifications
status.Failed: Failed: a reaction was refused or could not be sent

scenarioRunner.noReactions: Nothing has happened yet. No notification has arrived for these patients.

messageLog.title: FHIR message log
messageLog.description: Every FHIR exchange between this simulator and CareLoop, newest first.
messageLog.selectHint: Select an exchange to see its FHIR JSON.
